evaluation.packet_report_paths: blinded packet-local report copies with bound SHA-256 digests
evaluation.packet_private_binding: packet id + evaluator slot + path + full digest

derivation.private_provenance: manifest + raw request/execution evidence + graph + identity + private gold path/digest + source/copy report hashes + private report groups + full packet bindings
derivation.claim_mapping: each evaluator claim is referenced exactly once, grouped arm-blind, and mapped to a runtime private-gold id or null
derivation.strongest_recovery: all privately marked strongest outcomes weight 1 in a candidate run
derivation.unsupported_count: derived from high-confidence unsupported, unmatched, or negative-case finding claims in candidate reports
derivation.unmatched_false_positive_count: derived from high-confidence finding claims mapped to null
derivation.positive_recovery_rate: mean outcome weight over privately classified held-out cases
derivation.negative_false_positive_rate: negative-case and unmatched finding claims derived from validated private mappings
